## Pull request overview

This PR aims to resolve monorepo build issues and eliminate Tailwind CSS version conflicts by aligning the CRM example app with Tailwind v4, while also adjusting library bundling/externalization and adapter exports.

**Changes:**
- Align Tailwind to v4 across the repo (lockfile + CRM app dependency/CSS updates) and remove legacy Tailwind/PostCSS config files in the CRM example.
- Fix library bundling by marking additional workspace packages as Rollup externals for `@object-ui/layout` and `@object-ui/fields`.
- Loosen TypeScript build constraints in `@object-ui/data-objectstack` and stop exporting the moved ObjectStack adapter from `@object-ui/core`.

### Reviewed changes

Copilot reviewed 12 out of 13 changed files in this pull request and generated 4 comments.

<details>
<summary>Show a summary per file</summary>

| File | Description |
| ---- | ----------- |
| pnpm-lock.yaml | Updates lockfile to reflect Tailwind v4 and dependency graph changes. |
| packages/layout/vite.config.ts | Adds `@object-ui/react` to Rollup externals for layout library builds. |
| packages/fields/vite.config.ts | Adds `@object-ui/core` and `@object-ui/react` to Rollup externals for fields library builds. |
| packages/data-objectstack/tsconfig.json | Removes `rootDir` constraint to unblock DTS generation in a workspace context. |
| packages/core/src/adapters/index.js | Comments out ObjectStack adapter export after moving it to `@object-ui/data-objectstack`. |
| examples/crm-app/tailwind.config.js | Removes Tailwind v3 config from the CRM example app. |
| examples/crm-app/postcss.config.js | Removes PostCSS config from the CRM example app. |
| examples/crm-app/package.json | Bumps CRM app Tailwind dependency to v4.1.18. |
| examples/crm-app/src/index.css | Migrates Tailwind directives to v4-style import and adjusts base styles/variables. |
| examples/crm-app/src/schemas/dashboard.ts | Adds `x`/`y` coordinates to dashboard widget layouts. |
| examples/crm-app/src/components/SidebarNav.tsx | Removes unused React import. |
| examples/crm-app/src/components/SidebarNav.test.tsx | Removes unused React import. |
| examples/crm-app/src/App.tsx | Removes unused imports and trims unused data imports. |
</details>

`@object-ui/core` is now treated as an external, and `packages/fields/src/index.tsx` imports it (`ComponentRegistry`), but `@object-ui/core` is not declared in `packages/fields/package.json`. Please add it as a dependency/peerDependency so downstream consumers don’t get missing-module errors.
```suggestion

```

Tailwind v4 still needs a build-time integration (e.g. PostCSS via `@tailwindcss/postcss` + `postcss.config.js`, or the `@tailwindcss/vite` plugin). With `postcss.config.js` removed and no Tailwind plugin configured in `vite.config.ts`, `@import 'tailwindcss'` will not generate utilities and the app’s Tailwind classes won’t have any effect. Please add the appropriate Tailwind v4 integration (and dependency) back for this app.
```suggestion

```

`@object-ui/react` is now marked as Rollup external, but `packages/layout/src` imports it (e.g. `Page.tsx`). To avoid consumers hitting `Cannot find module '@object-ui/react'`, this package should declare `@object-ui/react` as a dependency or peerDependency (matching how you expect it to be provided).
```suggestion

```
